content: Agentic docs-as-code: GitHub Copilot supports custom agents (.agent.md personas) and reusable Agent Skills (SKILL.md packaging instructions+scripts+examples, injected into context on demand). A @docs-agent reading code to generate API docs/references/tutorials is a recommended early agent. Microsoft Copilot Tuning Document Writing agent generates long-form docs from reference examples/templates with customizable format/tone/style. AGENTS.md is the cross-tool standard (Copilot, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code) for project-specific agent context. Confirms skills/instructions-file customization is table stakes.
